title: SENDGUARD measurement cell
description: Canonical schema for one SENDGUARD measurement cell. Frozen at S00 per julying; status words live in spec/canonical.md (closed set). Any unknown status word -> VOID.

properties._note_format_version: rev3: was const "1" (string) while every port writes integer 1; both accepted, the value is not in the equality digest

length_unit.description: rev3: renamed from name_encoding. The old field name collided with spec/canonical.md, where name_encoding means how the recorded name BYTES are encoded (hex_utf16le / hex_raw_bytes) - a different concept. Both fields now exist with distinct names.

verdict_via.description: rev3 required: a legality verdict must name the tool that was asked (measured: .NET strips trailing U+00A0, cmd preserves it)

name_source.description: Hex-encoded sample name. Corpus discipline: never land a real forbidden name as a filesystem entry; hex only.

read_skipped_reason.description: rev4: required whenever read_result is not_applicable

mechanism_class.description: Closed set in spec/canonical.md; dedup key for external divergence counts.

implementation_id._note_pattern: SG-F8 (2026-10-12): renamed from worker_id. The producer field describes the artifact, not the studio: a value must name a lane, never a session, seat code or engine. Values that fail this pattern are a disclosure finding, and ci/process_leak_scan.py counts them. Old records keep validating - additionalProperties is true by design, so a port that recorded extra fields is not punished for it.
